## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in ToolBraid.

## Validation

- [ ] Targeted tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes when the change affects shared runtime code.
- [ ] Relevant browser E2E passes for UI, extension, or WebMCP lifecycle changes.
- [ ] No credentials, browser profiles, generated builds, model files, or private data are included.
- [ ] Origin, session, fingerprint, approval, replay, and audit bindings remain fail-closed.

## Evidence

List the commands run and attach only redacted screenshots or receipts.
